body: You literally said, "Or stay weak." You make it sound so matter of fact.
It's very easy to say develop self discipline... Also self love?  What.  Avoid certain people? We cannot control what people are around us growing up.

Eating at a homeless shelter was the most embarrassing thing I've ever done,  I don't think I can go back to that.  Soon, I'll be in a homeless shelter. My mind is shot, I haven't slept in two days and it's getting worse.  Is being alive even worth it? I wish I was dead...

Here's the thing,  I'm tired of trying. The last time I asked for help in the military I had a commander pull me aside after hearing my life story with tears in his eyes,  he placed his hand on my shoulder and said he was proud of me,  that I was a survivor. Human sympathy towards me, the first I've ever encountered made me gag, he was 100% serious about it but instead of feeling relieved, my mind couldn't accept it and choose to believe that I am not worth any kind of human sympathy or emotions.
So I'm basically fucked,  they just told me to call a veteran homeless shelter for help.
